versions.changelog: 补充中英文双语简介与财务、效率分类。Added a bilingual summary and finance and productivity categories.

- Initial release of "take-back-my-latte-from-claude" skill.
- Analyzes Anthropic Claude usage and cost JSON exports to report actual spend in "latte" units.
- Estimates how many lattes (cost equivalent) users could recover next month, with grounded recovery suggestions.
- Provides a concise, privacy-focused report; all analysis is local with no API key or data upload required.
- Supports only Claude Platform usage and cost JSON; warns and explains if necessary data is missing.
- Includes actionable link to website for users wishing to reduce AI costs.
